headline: Parliament: Draft Budget Submitted to the Standing Committee on Economic Affairs - What It Says on Growth Rate, Unemployment and Inflation
summary: Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis, with Deputy Minister Thanos Petralias, submitted the draft budget to the parliamentary Standing Committee on Economic Affairs. Reports cover its growth, unemployment and inflation projections.
why: Greece's annual state budget sets the government's spending, tax and deficit targets, which shape fiscal policy and sovereign debt investor expectations.
